production_notes: Production icons contain artwork only; spell names and costs are not baked into them.
Painted subjects occupy 90.6% of the 512 px canvas on their longest dimension, within the approved 88–92% range.
Battle-rack intent is approximately 60–68 px; all silhouettes are also inspected at 40 px for smaller uses.
Symmetry Ward and Thaw use the water palette and visibly liquid forms because their paid-in element overrides the discipline palette.
Ice is rendered as frozen water, snow, and hail rather than as blue gemstone material.
Lighting is consistently motivated from the upper-left.

assets.role: Cryomancer spell icon for Overcharge; paid in ice. A frozen hourglass abruptly arrests the creature's next action.
Cryomancer spell icon for Frost Armor; paid in ice. Layered frozen-water armour grants Block, retaliates when breached, and partly persists.
Cryomancer spell icon for Freeze; paid in ice. A resistance-knot is frozen open so the next incantation grants no Resistance.
Cryomancer spell icon for Symmetry Ward; paid in water. Opposing liquid currents form a ward strengthened by elemental diversity.
Cryomancer spell icon for Glacial Prison; paid in ice. Crossing ice ribs imprison one position and turn the hold into attack and protection.
Cryomancer spell icon for Cone of Cold; paid in ice. A directional freezing blast delays the next action and bites when it finally moves.
Cryomancer spell icon for Whiteout; paid in ice. A dense storm erases a shield, preventing wards from being raised.
Cryomancer spell icon for Thaw; paid in water. Melting armour becomes visibly liquid water and usable elemental power.
Cryomancer spell icon for Hailstorm; paid in ice. A consolidated barrage of rounded hail converts existing holds into repeated damage.
Cryomancer spell icon for Permafrost; paid in ice. Ancient frozen ground pins a shield and caps the creature's wards at one level.
